# R4.13a — BL-37 package part 2 — ADR-0214, 17 OQs (OQ-418 … OQ-458, incl. the OQ-441 DebtIndex re-pin)

## Summary

Part 2 of the pre-split BL-37 package (ADR-0214's 34 deferred Stage-4/5/6
stage-blocking questions): briefs the trailing seventeen OQs by register
order — OQ-418/420/424/430/432/433/434/435/436/438/441/446/448/450/453/
457/458 — appended to R4.13's
`docs/build/planning/round4-bl37-adr-0214-briefs.md` at the marked site.
The head `Operator act: "adopt all except: <ids>"` line already covers
both parts — GATE-G7's act is one sentence over all 34 rows. The ticket
never rules: every row is a FINAL *proposed* disposition; part 2 carries
no recording acts (nothing in scope is fully determined by a landed ADR
or GATE DECISION the way ADR-0306 D1 determined OQ-177). **OQ-441** — the
Stage-5 `DebtIndex` re-pin, WS-I6 — gets the contract's joint evaluation:
the post-CF-489 `DebtPolicy`/`DebtIndex` shapes (the landed placeholders
now match the proposals — 60 d runway / 30 d warn) are weighed jointly
with OQ-304's `evidence_max_age` note, and the final re-pin resolves to
*adopt the conformed defaults now; re-pin by amendment when the running
index supplies real aging data* — the entry test preserved verbatim as
the re-entry trigger.

Spec: `docs/tickets/162a_R4.13a__bl37-adr-0214-package-part2.md`.
Requirement ids: `BL-37` (part 2); ADR-0214; OQ-441 (WS-I6).

Highlights: OQ-418 — unconditional `attendance` inheritance answers
both halves; Π-12 covers the unattended slice. OQ-420 — declared-param
`bandit`, non-pooling cells; `lab/value-of-compute-v1` re-pin preserved.
OQ-424 — in-process `bind` + `variant_not_admitted` refusals ratified.
OQ-430 — the ADR-0192 touched-handles default is unimplemented → the
R4.15c leg (touched handles → selection → `MergeReport` surfaces).
OQ-432 — the ledgered `control.merge.resolved` reason is the basis.
OQ-433 — `hlc` top-level member + `require_hlc`-in-`share` (ADR-0193
K-2). OQ-434 — the landed `ChildOutcome` sum; `refused_at_spawn` =
`unknown` by construction. OQ-435/436/448 — pre-registered values stand;
6a/A13 re-pins preserved. OQ-438 — `rebase` replays the same edit.
OQ-446 — `OwnerRef{principal|team}` + `reach_via`/`OwnerUnreachable`
answer kind + reachability. OQ-450 — campaign data; refuse only at C1.
OQ-453 — provisional `configuration`-granularity admission. OQ-457 —
`guard_at_bind` + placeholders. OQ-458 — the selector-family default.

**OQ-441 — the joint note.** The post-CF-489 `DebtPolicy` values equal
this row's recorded proposals verbatim (60 d `min_runway` /
`InsufficientRunway`, 30 d `warn_within`, 90 d `hypothesized_max_age` —
the "one experiment cycle" arm is the ledgered probation `due_at_ms`,
DF-S5.4-1 — 30 d `grace_period` via `grace_elapsed` ∨ bound, 180 d
`evidence_max_age`). The `DebtIndex` fold (`debt_index`/`evaluate_debt`/
`DebtReport`) reads every constant from the policy at runtime — the
re-pin is a data amendment, never a code leg. Joint with OQ-304 (ADR-0197
D5): `evidence_max_age` ages only instrument-produced evidence via the
`evidence_refresh_due` fallback leg — Tier-A `source` refs never age by
themselves. The OQ-445 join (ADR-0210) is R4.8's `needs-code-leg(R4.15a)`
proposal on a different surface — the two dispositions stand
independently. Proposed: `adopt-interim-as-final` — the conformed values
are the ratified defaults; the Stage-5 `DebtIndex`-data re-pin is
preserved verbatim as the re-entry trigger.

No `descope-by-ADR` rows; no new CF rows (CF-489 resolved at R3.9 — the
conform is recorded on the register row and in the `debt.rs` comment).
